comments.author: OGrilla
comments.html: I enjoyed the fact that this time he was happy and she wasn’t. Can’t wait to read more of these.

comments.author: Ava
comments.html: I really love how with thirteen panels and six words, so much truth can be spoken.

comments.author: MicahelParshall
comments.html: I don’t know. On first glance, I thought the female lil bastard looked happy too because she was agreeing with him. When I was a child I remember having a great time at the beach even if my castle did get knocked down. It was the happiest I’ve ever been, really. Really good stuff. I thought about this one for awhile. Thank you.

comments.author: ADifferentRandomAsshole
comments.html:
Interesting metaphor for life. No matter what you accomplish in your lifespan eventually everything you ever build will be washed away.
You better have some fun.
